messages.text: For the joint audit sign-off we need both the finance lead and a director present.
Understood. Well coordinate a slot where both of us can attend.
Our side is flexible for the next two weeks.
Noted. Ill confirm a date once Ive spoken to our finance lead.

loops.statement: the finance lead and a director attend the audit sign-off together
loops.notes: Mutual with a counterparty who is neither of the two parties to the joint act. The obligation is owed to the auditor; the mutuality is internal to the subject's side.

loops.statement: confirm a date for the audit sign-off with the auditor
